title.zh: 在AI解决数学问题的一年，Anthropic可能刚攻下最大难题
title.en: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest

summary.zh: Anthropic一名数学家称，他用AI证明了著名的黎曼猜想，但完整验证仍需时间。若属实，这将是数学与AI领域的重大突破，目前结论尚待同行核验。
summary.en: A mathematician at Anthropic says he used AI to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis, though verification will take time. If confirmed, it would be a major breakthrough in mathematics and AI, but the claim still needs peer review.

reports.title: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest

title.zh: 仓促发布：Alessandro Masullo 与广义黎曼猜想
title.en: Hurried Announcement: Alessandro Masullo GRH

summary.zh: 一则匆忙发布的公告在 Hacker News 上引发热议，相关内容指向 Levent Alpöge 宣称证明了广义黎曼猜想（GRH），并附有论文 PDF。该帖获得约 1789 分、807 条评论，讨论热烈，但该证明尚未经过同行评审。
summary.en: A hurriedly posted item on Hacker News points to a claimed proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis by Levent Alpöge, linking to a PDF. The thread drew about 1,789 points and 807 comments, though the proof has not been peer reviewed.

reports.title: Hurried Announcement: Alessandro Masullo GRH

title.zh: Anthropic 七位创始人在创纪录 IPO 中各套现 2.8 亿美元
title.en: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO

summary.zh: 按上调后的每股 83 美元发行价计算，Anthropic 的七位创始人合计套现近 20 亿美元，每人约 2.8 亿美元。公司在这次创纪录的 IPO 中募资近 1050 亿美元。
summary.en: At the raised IPO price of $83 per share, Anthropic's seven founders each cashed out about $280 million, for nearly $2 billion in total. The company raised close to $105 billion in the record-breaking offering.

reports.title: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
AI进化速递丨Anthropic IPO募集资金总额约为935亿美元 - 第一财经

title.zh: AI抛售拖累Anthropic上市第二日，纳斯达克回吐2026年全部涨幅
title.en: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading

summary.zh: 纳斯达克综合指数回吐2026年全部涨幅，收于较1月1日下跌5%的水平，因AI板块抛售拖累Anthropic上市第二日交易。道指与标普500进入回调区间，投资者质疑投入AI基础设施的巨额资金。
summary.en: The Nasdaq Composite erased all its 2026 gains and closed 5% below its 1 January level as an AI sell-off weighed on Anthropic’s second trading day. The Dow and S&P 500 entered correction territory amid investor doubts over huge AI infrastructure spending.

reports.title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading

title.zh: 消息人士：英伟达会计处理成美国SEC调查焦点
title.en: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say - Reuters

summary.zh: 消息人士称，美国证券交易委员会对英伟达会计处理的调查成为焦点。路透社发布独家报道，但披露的细节有限。
summary.en: Sources say Nvidia’s accounting is a focus of a US Securities and Exchange Commission investigation, Reuters reported exclusively. Few additional details were disclosed.

reports.title: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say - Reuters

title.zh: 特朗普威胁对境外建设 AI 数据中心征收“巨额税收”
title.en: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US

summary.zh: 特朗普表示将对在美国境外建设数据中心的企业征收“巨额税收”，并称不会允许本国公司在海外建数据中心。与此同时，美国多州和城市正在限制新建数据中心的申请。
summary.en: President Donald Trump said he would impose a "tremendous tax" on companies building data centers outside the United States, vowing not to let domestic firms build them abroad. The threat comes as states and cities tighten restrictions on new data center applications.

reports.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad
Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
Trump vows to stop U.S. companies from building data centers abroad, threatens 'tremendous tax'

title.zh: Frostbite：由 AI 发现、设计与验证的全新 CPU 架构
title.en: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI

summary.zh: Architect Labs 博客称，一套名为 Frostbite 的新 CPU 架构由 AI 完成发现、设计与验证。该帖在 Hacker News 获 636 分、332 条评论，引发对 AI 参与芯片设计能力与可信度的讨论。
summary.en: A blog post from Architect Labs describes Frostbite, a new CPU architecture reportedly discovered, designed and verified by AI. The Hacker News thread drew 636 points and 332 comments, sparking debate over how far AI can be trusted in chip design.

reports.title: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI

title.zh: 英伟达股价重挫14%，创2008年金融危机以来最长周线连跌纪录
title.en: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis

summary.zh: 英伟达股价本周累计下跌14%，录得2008年金融危机以来最长的周线连跌。这家曾为全球市值最高的公司现已退居第四，位列苹果、微软和Alphabet之后。
summary.en: Nvidia fell 14% for the week, posting its longest weekly losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis. Once the world's most valuable company, it now ranks fourth behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet.

reports.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis

title.zh: 语言模型能够重写自身权重
title.en: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights

summary.zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文（编号 2611.21885）探讨语言模型直接改写自身权重的能力。该工作在 Hacker News 获 368 分、115 条评论，引发关于模型自我修改与安全风险的讨论。
summary.en: A paper on arXiv (2611.21885) examines whether language models can directly rewrite their own weights. Posted to Hacker News, it drew 368 points and 115 comments, prompting discussion of self-modifying models and associated safety risks.

reports.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights

title.zh: 英伟达高管风波余波未平，公司发布最新财报
title.en: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues

summary.zh: 报道称，在 CEO 黄仁勋离职风波持续发酵之际，英伟达本周公布财报，业绩增长稳健并预期景气延续。公司同时表示将停止在中国销售 H200 芯片，并拒绝了外界提出的一些要求。
summary.en: Nvidia reported quarterly results amid fallout from its ouster of CEO Jensen Huang, posting solid growth and promising more of the same. The chipmaker also said it will stop selling H200 chips in China and rejected some outside calls.

reports.title: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues

title.zh: 限制移动操作系统平台上的 AI 智能体截取数据
title.en: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data

summary.zh: Signal 在博客文章中呼吁限制移动操作系统平台上的 AI 智能体抓取用户数据，强调应保护隐私。该帖在 Hacker News 获 536 分、316 条评论。
summary.en: Signal published a blog post arguing that AI agents built into mobile operating system platforms should be restricted from capturing user data in the name of privacy. The Hacker News thread received 536 points and 316 comments.

reports.title: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data

title.zh: 加州调查英伟达芯片出口是否流入中国
title.en: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China

summary.zh: 加州总检察长向英伟达发出调查传票，调查其先进芯片出口是否最终流入中国、违反美国限制。邦塔称该丑闻“亮起明显红灯”，并要查明公司是否误导投资者；此前联合创始人兼长期CEO黄仁勋离职。
summary.en: California has subpoenaed Nvidia to investigate whether its advanced chip exports ended up in China in violation of US restrictions. Attorney General Rob Bonta said the scandal raises “bright red flags” and aims to determine if the company misled investors; co-founder and longtime CEO Jensen Huang has departed.

reports.title: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China

title.zh: Google 正推动厂商抵制 GrapheneOS 与解锁 Bootloader
title.en: Google is pushing OEMs against GrapheneOS and bootloader unlocking

summary.zh: GrapheneOS 项目在社交平台披露，Google 正施压 OEM 厂商，限制用户解锁 Bootloader 和安装第三方系统。该话题在 Hacker News 引发近 500 点热度与近 200 条讨论，焦点是 Android 开放性与用户自主权的边界。
summary.en: The GrapheneOS project says Google is pressuring device makers to restrict bootloader unlocking and third-party system installs. The claim drew heavy discussion on Hacker News, centering on Android openness and user control.

reports.title: Google is pushing OEMs against GrapheneOS and bootloader unlocking

title.zh: 苹果或在开发可操控 Mac 的自有 AI 智能体
title.en: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac

summary.zh: 有迹象显示，苹果正在构建可自主执行任务的 AI 智能体，目标是让 AI 直接操作 Mac。报道称其潜在竞争对手包括 Meta Muse、Instinct、Claude 与 OpenAI Dots 等产品。
summary.en: Apple appears to be building AI agents that can carry out tasks on a Mac, according to the report. The iPhone maker would be competing with Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude and OpenAI Dots.

reports.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac

title.zh: 特朗普在技术故障引发批评后撤换网络安全主管
title.en: Trump ousts cyber director after tech outages spark criticism - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，特朗普在技术故障引发批评后撤换网络安全主管。报道未提供更多细节。
summary.en: Reuters reports that Trump ousted the cyber director after tech outages sparked criticism. Few further details were provided in the source.

reports.title: Trump ousts cyber director after tech outages spark criticism - Reuters

title.zh: 特朗普称与中国和俄罗斯达成核军控限制将非常困难
title.en: Trump says nuclear arms limits with China, Russia will be very hard to achieve - Reuters

summary.zh: 特朗普表示，与中国和俄罗斯达成核军控限制将非常困难。路透社报道称，他没有进一步说明可能的时间表或谈判路径。
summary.en: Trump said reaching nuclear arms limits with China and Russia will be very hard to achieve, Reuters reported. He offered no further details on a possible timeline or negotiating path.

reports.title: Trump says nuclear arms limits with China, Russia will be very hard to achieve - Reuters

title.zh: 洛杉矶帕利塞兹山火纵火者被定罪
title.en: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles

summary.zh: 一名30岁洛杉矶居民因纵火引发帕利塞兹山火被定罪。该火灾造成12人死亡、超过6800栋建筑被毁。
summary.en: A 30-year-old Los Angeles resident was convicted of arson for starting the Palisades fire. The blaze killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

reports.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles

title.zh: 曼达尼宣布计划2032年前关闭纽约赖克斯岛监狱
title.en: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032

summary.zh: 曼达尼宣布计划在2032年前关闭纽约赖克斯岛监狱。该设施关闭计划可追溯至2019年市议会投票，但因囚犯安置地点争议而推迟。
summary.en: Mamdani announced a plan to close New York’s Rikers Island jail by 2032. The city council voted to close it in 2019, but delays arose over where to house inmates.

reports.title: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032

title.zh: 丹麦指控俄罗斯策划暗杀美乌双重国籍说唱歌手
title.en: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper

summary.zh: 丹麦指控俄罗斯策划暗杀一名美国与乌克兰双重国籍的说唱歌手。俄驻丹麦使馆否认指控，俄国防武官因此被驱逐。
summary.en: Denmark accused Russia of plotting to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper. The Russian embassy denied the allegation, and Russia’s defence attaché was expelled.

reports.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper

title.zh: AI做空交易开始获利了结？“大空头”Burry称英伟达、半导体ETF看跌期权均减半
title.en: AI做空交易开始获利了结？“大空头”Burry称英伟达、半导体ETF看跌期权均减半 - 华尔街见闻

summary.zh: “大空头”迈克尔·伯里表示，其持有的英伟达及半导体ETF看跌期权规模均已减半，被市场解读为对AI相关做空交易的获利了结信号。
summary.en: Michael Burry said he has halved his put positions on Nvidia and a semiconductor ETF, a move read as possible profit-taking on his bearish AI bets.

reports.title: AI做空交易开始获利了结？“大空头”Burry称英伟达、半导体ETF看跌期权均减半 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: Zscaler 股价大涨18%，此前有报道称 CrowdStrike 正洽谈收购该安全厂商
title.en: Zscaler stock jumps 18% on report that CrowdStrike in talks to buy security vendor

summary.zh: 有报道称 CrowdStrike 正就收购 Zscaler 进行洽谈，Zscaler 股价应声上涨18%。网络安全公司在人工智能时代持续寻求并购扩张。
summary.en: Zscaler shares jumped 18% after a report said CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire the security vendor. Cybersecurity companies have been hunting for acquisitions in the AI era.

reports.title: Zscaler stock jumps 18% on report that CrowdStrike in talks to buy security vendor

title.zh: Thinking Machines 发布 Inkling 2 Mini
title.en: Inkling 2 Mini

summary.zh: Thinking Machines 在其官网发布 Inkling 2 Mini，相关消息在 Hacker News 获得约 840 点热度。原文未提供更多技术细节。
summary.en: Thinking Machines announced Inkling 2 Mini on its website. The post drew roughly 840 points on Hacker News, though the listing offers few technical details.

reports.title: Inkling 2 Mini

title.zh: AI 中最被误解的图表迎来重大更新
title.en: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update

summary.zh: METR 更新其广受引用的“时间跨度”图表，称部分 AI 能力仍呈指数级提升。报告同时指出，模型在编程任务上的表现优于需要判断力的任务。
summary.en: METR has updated its widely cited time-horizon plot, finding some AI capabilities continue to improve exponentially. The report also indicates models perform better on coding than on tasks requiring judgment.

reports.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update

title.zh: 南非三个月内近600名女性被杀害
title.en: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months

summary.zh: 南非警方称，三个月内近600名女性被杀害。警方呼吁加大力度预防针对妇女和儿童的暴力。
summary.en: Nearly 600 women were killed in South Africa within three months, police said. Officials called for greater efforts to prevent violence against women and children.

reports.title: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months

title.zh: 为何 iOS 上至今没有非 WebKit 浏览器
title.en: Why there are still no non-WebKit browsers on iOS

summary.zh: Mozilla 在官方博客撰文，解释苹果的 iOS 浏览器引擎规则如何阻碍第三方内核浏览器进入。该文在 Hacker News 引发 300 余点热度与 200 多条讨论，涉及反垄断与平台开放之争。
summary.en: Mozilla explains in a blog post how Apple's iOS browser engine rules keep non-WebKit browsers off the platform. The article sparked hundreds of comments on Hacker News about competition and platform openness.

reports.title: Why there are still no non-WebKit browsers on iOS

title.zh: Signal 阻止 Gemini 与 Siri 读取屏幕内容
title.en: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen

summary.zh: Signal 在 Android 与 iOS 上限制截图功能，以阻止 AI 智能体读取用户消息等数据。其总裁称，操作系统内置的屏幕分析型 AI 能力正在削弱 Signal 独立保障隐私的能力。
summary.en: Signal is restricting screenshots on Android and iOS to stop AI agents from reading users' messages and other data. Its president said on-screen analysis built into operating systems undermines Signal's ability to independently guarantee privacy.

reports.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen

title.zh: 下任联合国秘书长角逐凸显大国分歧
title.en: Race to be next UN secretary general exposes divisions among world powers

summary.zh: 下任联合国秘书长角逐凸显世界大国之间的分歧。联合国安理会周五投票可能显示哥斯达黎加热门人选丽贝卡·格林斯潘是否会被大国阻挠，若遭阻挠将重新引发关于五常主导地位的争论。
summary.en: The race for the next UN secretary-general is exposing divisions among major powers. A Security Council vote on Friday may show whether Costa Rican frontrunner Rebeca Grynspan is blocked, potentially reviving debate over P5 dominance.

reports.title: Race to be next UN secretary general exposes divisions among world powers

title.zh: PostgreSQL 19 正式发布
title.en: PostgreSQL 19

summary.zh: PostgreSQL 19 发布，官方发布说明页面上线，并在技术社区引发讨论。作为重要版本更新，其具体功能与改进详见官方文档。
summary.en: PostgreSQL 19 has been released, with official release documentation now online and drawing community attention. The major version update's specific features and improvements are detailed in the official documentation.

reports.title: PostgreSQL 19

title.zh: Mac 版 Gemini 现可操控电脑
title.en: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer

summary.zh: 谷歌 macOS 版 Gemini 应用新增“电脑操作”能力，可跨本地文件、桌面应用和网页完成多步骤任务。谷歌称其可用于加速工作流、填写表单、制作演示和发布商品信息等。
summary.en: Google's Gemini app for macOS now supports computer use, helping users complete multi-step tasks across local files, desktop apps, and the web. Google says it can speed up workflows, fill forms, make presentations, and list items for sale.

reports.title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer

title.zh: 印度男子因参与暗杀美国锡克教分离主义领袖的阴谋被判19年以上监禁
title.en: Indian man sentenced to 19-plus years in plot to assassinate US-based Sikh separatist leader

summary.zh: 印度籍男子尼基尔·古普塔因参与暗杀一名旅美锡克教分离主义领袖的阴谋，被判处19年以上监禁。他已于今年2月认罪，承认雇凶杀人、共谋雇凶杀人及共谋洗钱等指控。
summary.en: Nikhil Gupta was sentenced to more than 19 years in prison for his role in a plot to assassinate a US-based Sikh separatist leader. He pleaded guilty in February to murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire and conspiracy to commit money laundering.

reports.title: Indian man sentenced to 19-plus years in plot to assassinate US-based Sikh separatist leader

title.zh: 美国10年期国债收益率下跌10个基点
title.en: 美国10年期国债收益率下跌10个基点 - 第一财经

summary.zh: 美国10年期国债收益率下行10个基点，显示资金流向避险资产或市场对利率路径预期发生调整，具体驱动因素有待后续数据与表态验证。
summary.en: The US 10-year Treasury yield fell 10 basis points, reflecting either a flight to safety or a shift in expectations for the interest-rate path.

reports.title: 美国10年期国债收益率下跌10个基点 - 第一财经

title.zh: 中国为何不愿成为全球下一个气候领袖
title.en: Why China is unwilling to be the world's next climate leader - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社发文分析中国为何不愿在全球气候治理中承担领导者角色。报道探讨了北京在气候议题上保持谨慎、不接替美国领导地位的多种考量。
summary.en: A Reuters analysis examines why China is reluctant to take on the role of the world's next leader on climate change, looking at the factors behind Beijing's cautious stance on global climate governance.

reports.title: Why China is unwilling to be the world's next climate leader - Reuters

title.zh: 特朗普的“个人化外交”在三角峰会中遭遇局限
title.en: Trump's personalized diplomacy hits its limits with 3-way summit - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道称，特朗普以领导人私人关系推动外交的做法在一次三方峰会中显现出局限。报道认为，这种高度个人化的斡旋方式难以应对多方博弈的复杂局面。
summary.en: Reuters reports that President Trump's personalized, leader-to-leader approach to diplomacy hit its limits during a three-way summit, underscoring the constraints of relying on personal relationships to broker complex multiparty deals.

reports.title: Trump's personalized diplomacy hits its limits with 3-way summit - Reuters

title.zh: 景顺长城黎海威：AI长期主线不变，但决定科技行情的还是盈利答卷
title.en: Invesco Great Wall's Li Haiwei: AI Remains a Long-Term Theme, but Earnings Will Decide the Tech Rally

summary.zh: 景顺长城基金黎海威表示，人工智能仍是长期投资主线，但科技板块行情能否延续，最终取决于企业盈利能否兑现。投资者应更关注基本面与业绩支撑。
summary.en: Invesco Great Wall fund manager Li Haiwei said AI remains a long-term investment theme, but the durability of the tech rally ultimately hinges on companies delivering earnings. Investors should focus on fundamentals and verified results.

reports.title: 景顺长城黎海威：AI长期主线不变，但决定科技行情的还是盈利答卷 - 第一财经

title.zh: 比亚迪在日本都做了些什么？
title.en: 比亚迪在日本都做了些什么？ | 电厂 - Jiemian.com

summary.zh: 界面新闻“电厂”栏目梳理比亚迪进入日本市场后的动作，包括车型投放、销售网络铺设与本地化合作，并评估其在中国以外成熟市场的推进节奏与挑战。
summary.en: Jiemian's Power Plant column reviews what BYD has done since entering Japan, covering model launches, dealer network buildout and local partnerships, and assesses the pace and obstacles of its expansion in a mature overseas market.

reports.title: 比亚迪在日本都做了些什么？ | 电厂 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 相隔大西洋的两个天才｜AI历史①
title.en: Two Geniuses Across the Atlantic | AI History (Part 1)

summary.zh: 财新推出“AI历史”系列，首篇讲述分处大西洋两岸的两位天才人物及其思想，追溯人工智能的起源脉络。
summary.en: Caixin launches an "AI History" series with a first installment profiling two brilliant figures on opposite sides of the Atlantic, tracing the intellectual origins of artificial intelligence.

reports.title: 相隔大西洋的两个天才｜AI历史① - 财新

title.zh: 黑海边被抛弃的度假天堂｜高加索散记
title.en: 黑海边被抛弃的度假天堂｜高加索散记 - 财新

summary.zh: 财新“高加索散记”专栏记录黑海沿岸一处已被废弃的度假胜地，通过实地走访描绘昔日繁华设施的现状，并借当地人的讲述还原其兴衰脉络。
summary.en: A Caixin travel essay from its Caucasus notes describes an abandoned resort paradise on the Black Sea coast, tracing its rise and decline through the site's ruins and local accounts.

reports.title: 黑海边被抛弃的度假天堂｜高加索散记 - 财新

title.zh: 数学谜题：最费劲的洗牌
title.en: Math Puzzle: The longest shuffle

summary.zh: 这是一道数学谜题，要求找出最费劲、最耗时的洗牌方式。它适合喜欢组合数学与算法思维的读者，可锻炼推理能力。虽属轻量内容，但值得谜题爱好者深入尝试。
summary.en: This math puzzle asks readers to find the most laborious possible shuffle. It is a light but engaging exercise for fans of combinatorics and algorithmic thinking. Worth trying for a quick mental challenge.

title.zh: AI可能已解决数学中最重要的难题
title.en: AI may have solved the most important problem in mathematics

summary.zh: 报道称，AI可能已解决黎曼猜想——人类尝试证明它已167年。若证明成立，这将是数学史上的重大突破，但结论仍需严格验证。文章值得阅读，以了解AI如何介入基础数学发现及其争议。
summary.en: Reports suggest AI may have solved the Riemann hypothesis, a problem humans have tried to prove for 167 years. If confirmed, it would be a landmark in mathematics, but the claim still requires rigorous verification. Worth reading to understand AI’s growing role in fundamental discovery and the debate around it.

title.zh: 独立数学家称AI黎曼猜想证明几乎肯定为真
title.en: The AI Riemann hypothesis proof is almost certainly true, independent mathematicians attest

summary.zh: 独立数学家正在核验一项声称的黎曼猜想证明，并表示其几乎肯定为真。研究者已接近完成验证。若获确认，这将是数学与AI研究的里程碑；值得关注同行评审与证明细节。
summary.en: Independent mathematicians are verifying a claimed proof of the Riemann hypothesis and say it is almost certainly true. Researchers are close to completing their checks. If confirmed, it would be a milestone for mathematics and AI; the verification details are worth following.

title.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆的欧盟协议只是起点
title.en: Andy Burnham’s EU deal is only a start

summary.zh: 文章认为，安迪·伯纳姆达成的欧盟协议只是起点，而扩大协议将十分困难。这种扩展难题正是问题所在，涉及政治与制度障碍。读者可借此观察英欧关系与地方政治互动。
summary.en: The article argues that Andy Burnham’s EU deal is only a starting point, and expanding it will be difficult. That difficulty is the problem, given political and institutional barriers. It is worth reading for insight into UK-EU relations and local politics.

title.zh: “我精于欺骗”：一名复饮酗酒者的秘密生活——播客
title.en: ‘I perfected deception’: My secret life as a relapsed alcoholic – podcast

summary.zh: 这是一期播客或长读，作者讲述自己复饮酗酒后如何隐瞒真相。第一次成瘾时众人皆知，但在戒酒11年后复发时，连丈夫都不知情。适合关注成瘾、欺骗与亲密关系的读者。
summary.en: This podcast and long read tell the story of a relapsed alcoholic who perfected deception. Everyone knew about the first addiction, but after 11 years sober, even the author’s husband did not know about the relapse. Worth reading for its intimate look at addiction, secrecy and relationships.
